import time
import tkinter as tk
import pyautogui

grades = [
    'Pass',
    'Excellent',
    'Pass',
    'Fail',
    'Above average',
    'Average',
    'Pass',
    'Average',
    'Fail',
    'Above average',
    'Fail',
    'Average',
    'Exceptional"'!'"',
]
text = '\\n'.join(grades)
root = tk.Tk()
root.withdraw()
root.clipboard_clear()
root.clipboard_append(text)
root.update()

time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'v')
time.sleep(0.4)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's')
time.sleep(0.8)
root.destroy()
print('pasted_and_saved')
